user.title: Add a Tuya device
user.description: {count} device(s) were heard on the network and are not configured yet. Pick one, or enter a device by hand.

manual.title: Enter a Tuya device
manual.description: You need the device id and its local key. See the documentation for offline ways to obtain the key.

credentials.title: Local key
credentials.description: Device {device_id} at {host}. Paste the local key and confirm the protocol version; Home Assistant will connect to check.

profile.title: Choose a profile
profile.description:
Live data points: {dps}.

A profile decides which entities are created. Pick a bundled profile, let Home Assistant detect one, or choose Raw.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device. Check the IP address and that no other app holds the connection.
error.invalid_key: The device refused the local key (or the protocol version is wrong).

set_dp.name: Set data point
set_dp.description: Write a raw value to a device data point.

dump_dps.name: Dump data points
dump_dps.description: Return every data point and its value.

reload_profiles.name: Reload profiles
reload_profiles.description: Re-read profiles from disk and reload all entries.
